_comment: The test world's roster (API-48, API-58): the innkeeper of the Crossing Inn, by the wagon whenever the party is at the inn. The inn has no scene of its own, so she stands in the road scene, but only while the caravan is at the inn. Not shipped content. Old Tobin owns the caravan and lives on no place: a mention places him wherever the party is (API-58). He is a carter, the test world's one people (API-63): a player learns of the carters only once they have seen or heard of him.

peoples.name: the carters
peoples.line: Old road families who haul for anyone with coin.
peoples.line_ru: Старые дорожные семьи: возят для всякого, у кого есть монета.

npcs.name: Wren the innkeeper
npcs.notes: Keeps the Crossing Inn; hears every rumour from the hills before anyone in town.
npcs.look: A broad woman in a flour-white apron.
npcs.heard: They say she hears every rumour from the hills first.

npcs.name: Old Tobin
npcs.look: An old carter with a pipe he never lights.
npcs.heard: They say he has driven the vale road forty years.

remembers.you: You dragged the fallen tree off the road for his wagon.
remembers.company: Your company dragged the fallen tree off the road for his wagon.
remembers.you_ru: Вы сами стащили упавшее дерево с дороги, чтобы прошла его телега.
remembers.company_ru: Ваш отряд стащил упавшее дерево с дороги, чтобы прошла его телега.

npcs.notes: Owns the test caravan; sings when the road is long.
